Name: Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park
Description: A concentration of largely unexcavated archaeological, historic, and living cultural heritage properties.

Name: Rani Ki Vav
Description: A stepwell located on the banks of Saraswati River. Built as a memorial to a king by his widowed queen.

Name: Historic City of Ahmadabad
Description: The walled city of Ahmadabad founded in the 15th century. A blend of Hindu, Islamic, and Jain architecture.

Name: Dholavira: A Harappan City
Description: One of the most prominent archaeological sites of Indus Valley Civilization. Features sophisticated water management and urban planning.
